SAMPLE_ITEMS = [
    {"servicio": "Colchón Queen", "cantidad": 1, "precio_unit": 45.0, "subtotal": 45.0}
]


def test_guardar_cotizacion_inserts_row(tmp_db):
    tmp_db.guardar_cotizacion("Ana López", "61234567", SAMPLE_ITEMS, 45.0, 0, 0.0, 45.0)
    rows = tmp_db.obtener_cotizaciones()
    assert len(rows) == 1
    assert rows[0]["cliente"] == "Ana López"


def test_guardar_cotizacion_serialises_items(tmp_db):
    tmp_db.guardar_cotizacion("Cliente", "60000000", SAMPLE_ITEMS, 45.0, 0, 0.0, 45.0)
    row = tmp_db.obtener_cotizaciones()[0]
    assert isinstance(row["items"], list)
    assert row["items"][0]["servicio"] == "Colchón Queen"


def test_guardar_cotizacion_stores_discount(tmp_db):
    tmp_db.guardar_cotizacion("Cliente", "60000000", SAMPLE_ITEMS, 45.0, 10, 4.5, 40.5)
    row = tmp_db.obtener_cotizaciones()[0]
    assert row["descuento_pct"] == 10
    assert row["descuento_monto"] == pytest.approx(4.5)
    assert row["total"] == pytest.approx(40.5)


def test_guardar_cotizacion_special_chars_in_name(tmp_db):
    tmp_db.guardar_cotizacion("José Ñoño", "60000000", SAMPLE_ITEMS, 45.0, 0, 0.0, 45.0)
    row = tmp_db.obtener_cotizaciones()[0]
    assert row["cliente"] == "José Ñoño"


def test_guardar_cotizacion_multiple_items(tmp_db):
    items = [
        {"servicio": "Colchón Queen", "cantidad": 2, "precio_unit": 45.0, "subtotal": 90.0},
        {"servicio": "Sofá 2 Puestos", "cantidad": 1, "precio_unit": 30.0, "subtotal": 30.0},
    ]
    tmp_db.guardar_cotizacion("Cliente", "60000000", items, 120.0, 0, 0.0, 120.0)
    row = tmp_db.obtener_cotizaciones()[0]
    assert len(row["items"]) == 2

    assert stats["total_ventas"] is None or stats["total_ventas"] == 0


def test_stats_totales_counts_correctly(tmp_db):
    tmp_db.guardar_cotizacion("A", "60000001", SAMPLE_ITEMS, 45.0, 0, 0.0, 45.0)
    tmp_db.guardar_cotizacion("B", "60000002", SAMPLE_ITEMS, 30.0, 0, 0.0, 30.0)
    stats = tmp_db.stats_totales()
    assert stats["total_cot"] == 2
    assert stats["total_ventas"] == pytest.approx(75.0)

import pytest
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent.parent))


@pytest.fixture
def db(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import database
    monkeypatch.setattr(database, "DB_PATH", tmp_path / "test.db")
    database.init_db()
    return database


ITEMS = [
    {"servicio": "Colchón King", "cantidad": 1, "precio_unit": 55.0, "subtotal": 55.0},
    {"servicio": "Sofá en L",    "cantidad": 1, "precio_unit": 60.0, "subtotal": 60.0},
]


def test_save_then_retrieve_preserves_all_fields(db):
    db.guardar_cotizacion("Pedro Pérez", "61111111", ITEMS, 115.0, 5, 5.75, 109.25)
    rows = db.obtener_cotizaciones()
    assert len(rows) == 1
    r = rows[0]
    assert r["cliente"] == "Pedro Pérez"
    assert r["whatsapp"] == "61111111"
    assert r["subtotal"] == pytest.approx(115.0)
    assert r["descuento_pct"] == 5
    assert r["descuento_monto"] == pytest.approx(5.75)
    assert r["total"] == pytest.approx(109.25)
    assert len(r["items"]) == 2


def test_stats_after_multiple_saves(db):
    db.guardar_cotizacion("A", "60000001", ITEMS, 115.0, 0, 0.0, 115.0)
    db.guardar_cotizacion("B", "60000002", ITEMS, 115.0, 10, 11.5, 103.5)
    stats = db.stats_totales()
    assert stats["total_cot"] == 2
    assert stats["total_ventas"] == pytest.approx(218.5)


def test_limit_does_not_return_extra_rows(db):
    for i in range(10):
        db.guardar_cotizacion(f"C{i}", "60000000", ITEMS[:1], 55.0, 0, 0.0, 55.0)
    assert len(db.obtener_cotizaciones(limit=5)) == 5


def test_historial_row_structure_for_ui(db):
    """Verify the dict keys the UI iterates over are present."""
    db.guardar_cotizacion("Test", "60000000", ITEMS, 115.0, 0, 0.0, 115.0)
    row = db.obtener_cotizaciones()[0]
    for key in ("fecha", "cliente", "whatsapp", "items", "descuento_pct", "total"):
        assert key in row

def test_guardar_cotizacion_zero_total(db):
